The owner approved both external transfers: “Approve both Fable audit transfers.”

The blind call completed and was independently verified: served `anthropic/claude-fable-5.1`, `xhigh`, no retries, all five result channels zero, output digest and 43 sealed inputs unchanged, actual owner processes absent. Its 14 observations are leads, not 14 accepted defects. The second, refutation call started at 18:39:06 UTC under `/tmp/pixelelated-m7-p4-fable-refutation-01`; active host supervision remains the result-delivery mechanism. No off-session alert is claimed.

Can the next verification be done on the VM? **Yes.** After verifying the second response, a fresh pair from unchanged candidate14 will test ten bounded synthetic local-WebDAV scenarios: a kept sibling's discarded-save shelf, interrupted-record fingerprint handling (including the token-exclusion control), second-pointer write failures in join/follow/settle, rejected exported-config and valid escaped-value readers, and offered content folders with ordinary, spaced and dotted names. Only owned guest config and synthetic QA endpoint data change; no hosted cloud or physical device is involved. Expected evidence is per-case before/after cloud hashes, pointers, stdout/exit codes, injected-fault receipt, installed-script hash equality, and actual cleanup of both guests/backend/ports.

Prepared, **not started**: `evidence/reviewer-leads-01/probe.py`, owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-p4-reviewer-leads-01`. All source and harness inputs are sealed. The external-review grading gate remains in Phase4.6; no product patch, final punch list, P4 closure or RC claim yet.
